commitResults.messageBody:
The Java classes use the default package, which does not follow the
project coding standard and weakens source organization.

Move production and test classes into the otaku package, update the
Gradle entry point, and extract the repeated event format error so the
affected lines remain within the standard's length limit.

commitResults.messageTitle: Mandate the SE-EDU Java coding standard
commitResults.messageBody:
Future Java changes need a durable project-specific reference for the
coding conventions expected by the course.

Add a reusable skill summarizing the official basic and intermediate
rules, and require agents to load it for Java work in this project.

commitResults.messageTitle: Mandate the SE-EDU Git standard
commitResults.messageBody:
Commit quality depends on applying the same message conventions across
future project work.

Add a reusable skill covering cohesive commits, imperative subjects, and
explanatory bodies, and require agents to load it for Git operations.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add task search by description keyword
commitResults.messageBody:
Users cannot narrow the task list when looking for a specific item.

Add a find command that validates its keyword and displays matching task
descriptions in list order. Cover matching, missing keywords, no matches,
and unchanged task state with unit and UI tests.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add JavaFX GUI for Level 10
commitResults.messageBody: Introduce an FXML-based chat interface with reusable dialog boxes, keyboard and button input, and a dedicated JavaFX launcher. Refactor Otaku into a shared response API so the GUI and CLI retain the same command processing, persistence, and error handling. Add cross-platform JavaFX dependencies and tests for response state and persistence.

commitResults.messageTitle: Use varargs for application entry points
Organize classes into Java packages
commitResults.messageBody: Group tasks, storage, commands, exceptions, and JavaFX controllers by responsibility. Update Gradle, FXML, tests, and setup documentation to use the new fully qualified class names.

commitResults.messageTitle: Otaku: wrap task-number parser declaration
commitResults.messageBody:
The task-number parser declaration reaches the 120-character line
limit.

Wrap the parameter list so the code complies with the SE-EDU Java
coding standard while preserving its behavior.
